text:
ashley.pm: Ok team — we need to lock the go-to-production criteria for the inference billing pilot. Scope: SLA tiers, docs, support rota, monitoring alerts, and pricing guardrails. I want concrete owners + a minimal acceptance checklist by EOD.

mike.eng: I can own SLA definitions (p99 latency, availability SLOs). Will align with Sam on thresholds.

sam.sre: For alerts we need error-budget burn, latency spike, and KV cache eviction alerts. I want runbook drafts before canary.

olivia.docs: I'll take API docs + troubleshooting and the 'what-to-expect' latency/throughput page. Need sample payloads and typical model variants.

jordan.finance: Pricing guardrails: propose 3 tiers (dev, standard, enterprise) + burst cap rules. I need usage projections and cost per token from Mike to size tiers.

nina.support: Support handoff: recommend 2-week on-call overlap with SRE + a pager flow. I can make the initial playbook and triage checklist.

ashley.pm: Nice. Quick decisions:
- SLA tiers: dev (best-effort), standard (p99 <= 250ms), enterprise (p99 <= 120ms + uptime SLA)
- Docs: API quickstart + troubleshooting + billing FAQ
- Support: 24/7 pager for enterprise only, business hours for standard
- Monitoring: error budget, spike, infra OOM
- Pricing: three tiers + soft throttle at 95% commit
Confirm owners? If so I'll file the acceptance doc and link the handoff ticket.

mike.eng: Confirmed owner for SLA and perf numbers. I'll provide token-cost estimates by 1600 UTC.

sam.sre: Confirmed owner for alerts and runbooks. Will add playbook link later in thread.

olivia.docs: Confirmed. I'll draft quickstart + troubleshooting page, and a short 'how we measure latency' blurb.

jordan.finance: Confirmed. Will post proposed tier prices and burst policy within 3 hours.

nina.support: Confirmed. I'll stub the support rota and escalation matrix.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy triggered: inference-billing-pilot-canary @team at 2024-11-14T21:30:00Z :rocket:

ashley.pm: Thanks. If everyone posts their artifacts (doc links / PRs / tickets) I'll consolidate into the Launch Acceptance doc and circulate for signoff. Priority items for signoff: SLA wording, alert thresholds, docs links, pricing table, support rota.

mike.eng: PR incoming for SLA doc: github.com/redwood/sla/pull/278

sam.sre: Runbook draft: docs-internal/redwood/runbooks/inference-billing.md (WIP)

olivia.docs: Quickstart PR: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1123

jordan.finance: Pricing draft spreadsheet: drive.redwood/pricing/inference-pilot (link posted in thread)

nina.support: Support rota doc: confluence.redwood/support/inference-pilot (link)

ashley.pm: Great. I'll assemble and ping for final signoff tomorrow morning. If anyone sees blockers call them out here now.

mike.eng: One potential blocker: model quantization increases latency variance for smaller batch sizes. We should add an SLO exception path or fallback variant.

ashley.pm: Good catch — add fallback variant to acceptance criteria. I'll mark as action item.

sam.sre: Also request: explicit SLACK alert routing for oncall + ops runbook link in the pager.

olivia.docs: I'll include the fallback variant note in troubleshooting and sample prompts to reproduce. :+1:

ashley.pm: Thanks all. Filing acceptance doc now and adding owners/actions. Will @channel when ready.
